result.final_text:
## What this letter says

This letter asks you to book an eye check. It is your yearly diabetes eye check (diabetic eye screening). The check looks at the back of your eyes. It looks for damage caused by diabetes (diabetic retinopathy). This check does not find other eye problems. It does not replace your normal eye test at an optician.

## What you need to do

1. Book your check by 15 January 2027.
2. To book, call 01632 960 377.
3. Bring sunglasses if you have them.
4. Bring your glasses or contact lenses.
5. Bring a list of your medicines.
6. At the check, staff will put drops in your eyes. The drops make your eyes blurry for 4 to 6 hours.
7. Do not drive until your eyes see normally again.

## Dates and medicines

- 15 January 2027: the last day to book your check.
- The letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor

- What does "diabetic retinopathy" mean?
- How will I get home after the eye drops?
- When and how will I get my results?

## When to get urgent help

The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
